correctness.rationale: Orthogonal monomial basis e_n makes H_ke_n pairwise orthogonal by distinct angular frequencies, and the analytic projection coefficient gives the exact d_{n,k}. The Gamma product r_k(n) increases and d_{n,k}>0. Uniform Gamma-ratio convergence holds on scaled compact intervals, while d_{n,k}<=2pk^2/n^2 for n>=2k; this gives norm tightness, threshold counting and Schatten q>1 dominated Riemann sums. The derivative sign of F_p for x>1 reduces to the one-zero function g_p(y)=(p-1)log(1-y)+(p+1)log(1+y), with g_p^\prime(y)=2(1-py)/(1-y^2); this proves the p<=1 edge/p>1 interior split. Telescoping yields exact Hilbert–Schmidt trace k, a known fact not novelty. Independent rational beta moments checked p=1..4 and k=1..9, exact finite trace and p=1 maximizer.
